sentences.en: I'm afraid my child might be prone to take drugs.
sentences.zh: 我恐怕我的孩子可能会吸毒。

sentences.en: One is more prone to make mistakes when one is tired.
sentences.zh: 人在疲惫时更容易出错。

sentences.en: People who are prone to aggression can be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 容易好斗的人可能很危险。
